# Manuscript

> A statically typed language with explicit contracts, named arguments, scoped cleanup, explicit concurrency, and capability parameters. The compiler lowers to Go.

Links are relative to this file so GitHub Pages project paths and custom domains work alike.

## Learn
- [Introduction](learn/): audience, features, and reading order
- [Get started](learn/getting-started/): a complete application and CLI commands
- [Language tour](learn/tour/): functions, data, and expected failures

## Implemented API
- [Entire standard library as Markdown](stdlib.md): every standard module, intrinsic prelude, generic bound, field, case, operation, and special call rule
- [Standard library JSON](stdlib.json): versioned structured declaration snapshot
- [Module reference](standard-library/reference/): browsable generated pages
